marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 25 knots diminishing to south 15 Wednesday
morning. Flurries ending Wednesday morning. Risk of freezing drizzle
today. Fog patches forming Wednesday morning. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
flurries and 1 mile or less in fog patches. Temperatures minus 2 rising to plus 3 Wednesday
morning. <br/>
